ingredients: Coconut - 1 half, chopped into small pieces
method: Grind the parboiled rice, raw rice, toor dal, chana dal, dry red chilies, asafoetida, and salt together coarsely.
Add the chopped onion, chopped coconut pieces, and pinched curry leaves to the batter.
Mix everything well and dilute the batter with a little water.
Pour it lightly onto a hot griddle, add plenty of oil around the edges, and cook until it becomes crispy.
Serve hot with chutney or jaggery.
